newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMERCIAL BANK LAUNCHES BANCASSURANCE PRODUCTS.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK LAUNCHES BANCASSURANCE PRODUCTS.

text.p: Commercial Bank, Greece's second largest retail bank, is launching two bancassurance products, it said in a statement.
Developed in association with its subsidiary Metrolife Insurance, Syntaxi-pension and Kid Plan quarantee capital payments between 5.0 and 20.0 million drachmas.
Both products offer flexibility in monthly payments which may vary between 10,000 and 60,000 drachmas.
Customers are also free to make additional payments and liquidate part or all of the accumulated capital before the scheme's expiration.
Syntaxi and Kid Plan will be marketed through the nationwide branch network of Commercial Bank and Metrolife Insurance. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
